content.text: I am applying for the Community Centre Support Assistant role, reference 0007. I am interested in community information services. As a volunteer reception helper at Eastbank Community Room from September 2025 to February 2026, I welcomed visitors and explained room locations using a printed session list. I referred booking enquiries to the coordinator. I entered attendance totals in a simple spreadsheet and checked them against the paper register. During work experience at Cedar Lane Books from May to June 2025, I arranged stock using shelf labels and a checklist, and reported missing labels to a supervisor.
